74afa6f392.why: Each input requires widening and byte duplication, and the broadcast mask in ymm8 is itself a required final value.

9c0a8c60a1.why: The three independent expansions each require two AVX2 operations, and the mask, load result, pointer update and flags must all be preserved.

a2acadb2dd.why: Each of the four inputs needs two operations to expand and duplicate its low sixteen bytes, while the broadcast mask remains live.

dd314102a5.why: Both the extracted high half and saturated packed result are live, and vzeroupper also clears upper halves of other preserved registers.

578cb40cf6.why: Both extracted halves and both packed results must remain, and vzeroupper has required effects on other live vector registers.

34aa7aa483.why: The three extracted halves and three saturated pack results are all required, along with the upper-half clearing performed by vzeroupper.

18277b8fe2.why: All four extracted halves and packed outputs are live, and removing vzeroupper would leave other preserved upper halves uncleared.

26c3a63033.why: The loaded count in ymm8, shifted vector, scalar load and pointer update with matching flags are all required final results.

238e9fdc49.why: The live count load is already shared by both necessary shifts, and the scalar load and flag-setting pointer update cannot be dropped.

7642319e9f.why: Each of the three vectors requires its own shift, while the shared count, scalar load result and pointer update are also live.

f7619c774a.why: Four independent vector shifts already share one required count load, and the scalar load and pointer update must be retained.

8c4c524bb9.why: The three independent logical shifts share a live count register, and both loads and the flag-setting pointer update are necessary.

ef08b9e217.why: Both equality masks require comparisons, and the constant vector in ymm8 is a required final value that prevents folding away its load.

373c02db35.why: Arbitrary input bits require both shifts and both OR operations per output, and AVX2 has no ternary OR to combine the merges.

97fd3960ab.why: The shifts isolate the required fields, and constructing a shared low-nibble mask would cost as many instructions as it saves.

01dd41f445.why: The shifts extract all required fields, and synthesizing a shared five-bit mask does not reduce the instruction count.

1780bdbf24.why: Each input needs its high field and two bounded lower fields, and constructing masks for the five-bit and six-bit fields cannot shorten this sequence.

c3d2e4e372.why: AVX2 needs the high-half extraction and two widening operations to produce both required vectors from the full input.

5fd76963c2.why: Each input requires a high-half extraction and two widening operations, with all four widened outputs preserved.

1b7ead8850.rewrite:
mov r8,QWORD PTR [rsi]
vpermq ymm0,ymm0,0xd8
vpunpckhbw ymm4,ymm0,ymm0
vpunpcklbw ymm0,ymm0,ymm0
vpermq ymm1,ymm1,0xd8
vpunpckhbw ymm5,ymm1,ymm1
vpunpcklbw ymm1,ymm1,ymm1
vpermq ymm2,ymm2,0xd8
vpunpckhbw ymm6,ymm2,ymm2
vpunpcklbw ymm2,ymm2,ymm2
vpermq ymm3,ymm3,0xd8
vpunpckhbw ymm7,ymm3,ymm3
vpunpcklbw ymm3,ymm3,ymm3
vbroadcasti128 ymm8,XMMWORD PTR [CONST_1]
add rsi,0x20
1b7ead8850.why: Permuting qwords into order 0,2,1,3 lets self-unpacks directly duplicate every byte into the correct low-half and high-half output vectors, replacing five operations with three per input. The broadcast remains to preserve ymm8, and the scalar load and flag-setting pointer update are unchanged.
